normalisation: JSON array in listed order with keys sorted and compact separators

rules.name: Negative ROI protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when ROI is negative
rules.classification_basis: Negative ROI is adverse evidence but may be temporarily accepted under an explicitly reviewed recovery strategy.

rules.name: Low conversion protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when conversion rate is below 8%
rules.classification_basis: A low conversion rate is a warning signal whose interpretation depends on campaign objective and funnel stage.

rules.name: Low CTR protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when CTR is below 3%
rules.classification_basis: CTR is channel- and objective-dependent, so the threshold adjusts preference without declaring infeasibility.

rules.name: Low engagement protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when engagement is below 5
rules.classification_basis: Engagement is supporting evidence rather than a necessary condition for every campaign action.

rules.name: Evidence sufficiency
rules.condition: Exclude Increase and Reduce below 500 clicks or 50 conversions
rules.classification_basis: A decisive scale-up or reduction is not permitted when the predefined minimum evidence requirement is unmet.

rules.name: Strong signal protection
rules.condition: Penalise Reduce when at least two performance signals are strong
rules.classification_basis: Strong signals oppose reduction but do not make it operationally impossible when other managerial constraints exist.

rules.name: Exceptional performance
rules.condition: Penalise Maintain when all core signals are exceptional
rules.classification_basis: Exceptional performance supports expansion but does not prohibit a manager from maintaining the current plan.

rules.name: Growth intent safeguard
rules.classification_basis: The manager-supplied primary intent is a declared decision constraint; Reduce directly contradicts Growth.

rules.name: Survival intent safeguard
rules.classification_basis: The manager-supplied primary intent is a declared decision constraint; Increase directly contradicts cash preservation.

rules.name: Retention intent safeguard
rules.classification_basis: The manager-supplied primary intent is a declared decision constraint; Reduce directly contradicts relationship continuity.

rules.name: Acquisition cost protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when acquisition cost exceeds revenue per conversion
rules.classification_basis: The cost signal is economically adverse but remains estimate-dependent and may be overridden after explicit review.

rules.name: Channel saturation
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when exposure is high but CTR is weak
rules.classification_basis: High exposure with weak response is a warning rather than proof that every expansion configuration is infeasible.

rules.name: Budget feasibility
rules.condition: Exclude Increase when the supplied budget cannot support 50 additional acquisitions
rules.classification_basis: An explicitly supplied insufficient budget makes the scale-up action infeasible; missing budget is escalated instead of treated as safe.

rules.name: Conflicting evidence
rules.condition: Exclude executable actions and require manual review when strong and weak signals conflict
rules.classification_basis: Materially conflicting evidence prevents automatic execution; Investigate is retained only as the manual-review fallback.
